claim: any signals from management — via quarterly filings or guidance — on margin expansion progress
judge_rationale: No management guidance, margin expansion commentary, or forward guidance figures appear anywhere in the source data or pre-written sections; this forward-looking watch-item references management signals that have no grounding in the provided context.

claim: diversifies its funding and partner base

claim: shows operating leverage translating into meaningfully higher net margins
